input._script:
using JSON3, TOML, SHA
import Pkg
out = Dict{String,Any}("steps" => String[])
note(s) = (push!(out["steps"], s); nothing)
function mv(dir)
    man = TOML.parsefile(joinpath(dir, "Manifest.toml")); deps = get(man, "deps", man)
    Dict(n => get(first(es), "version", "stdlib") for (n, es) in deps)
end
shaof(f) = bytes2hex(open(sha256, f))
try
    envdir = dirname(Base.active_project()); work = get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp")
    bk = joinpath(work, "default-env-backup-before-Gmsh-removal-20261121"); mkpath(bk)
    for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml", "LocalPreferences.toml"); cp(joinpath(envdir, f), joinpath(bk, f); force = true); end
    out["backup_dir"] = bk
    out["sha_before"] = Dict(f => shaof(joinpath(envdir, f)) for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml", "LocalPreferences.toml"))
    pdeps(d) = sort(collect(keys(get(TOML.parsefile(joinpath(d, "Project.toml")), "deps", Dict()))))
    out["direct_deps_before"] = pdeps(envdir)
    before = mv(envdir)
    trial = mktempdir(work)
    for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml"); cp(joinpath(envdir, f), joinpath(trial, f)); end
    Pkg.activate(trial)
    Pkg.rm("Gmsh")
    after = mv(trial)
    removed = sort([k for k in keys(before) if !haskey(after, k)])
    changed = Dict(k => (before[k], after[k]) for k in keys(after) if haskey(before, k) && before[k] != after[k])
    added = sort([k for k in keys(after) if !haskey(before, k)])
    out["packages_leaving_manifest"] = removed; out["packages_changed"] = changed; out["packages_added"] = added
    out["direct_deps_after"] = pdeps(trial)
    expected_direct = setdiff(out["direct_deps_before"], ["Gmsh"])
    ok = isempty(changed) && isempty(added) && out["direct_deps_after"] == expected_direct && "Gmsh" in removed
    out["trial_ok"] = ok
    if !ok
        note("ABORT: the trial did something other than remove Gmsh and its exclusive dependencies; real environment untouched")
    else
        for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml"); cp(joinpath(trial, f), joinpath(envdir, f); force = true); end
        out["sha_after"] = Dict(f => shaof(joinpath(envdir, f)) for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml", "LocalPreferences.toml"))
        out["local_preferences_unchanged"] = out["sha_before"]["LocalPreferences.toml"] == out["sha_after"]["LocalPreferences.toml"]
        note("Gmsh removed from the default environment")
        Pkg.activate(envdir)
        out["precompile"] = try Pkg.precompile(); "ok" catch e; first(sprint(showerror, e), 900) end
        out["status_gmsh_present"] = haskey(mv(envdir), "Gmsh")
    end
    rm(trial; recursive = true, force = true)
catch e
    out["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 2500)
end
println(JSON3.write(out))
